args.prompt: Create one production reference frame, 16:9 photorealistic Chinese historical film still. Image 1 locks EXACT same Wei Yan face, age, short beard, headcloth with small bronze patch, dark red scarf and sleeves and plate armor; preserve his facial identity, no beautification. Image 2 is ONLY a night exposure/color reference, do not copy tent gate or notice board. Show Wei Yan alone, medium-wide knees-up, in the SAME rough canvas dispatch canopy as image 1, near the left-center of frame facing the camera, mouth closed, weight settled. Widen to show the dispatch wooden table on far left and the open canopy exit on far right. A single warm hanging lantern attached to right canopy post illuminates naturally; outside fully night with charcoal blue sky, NO pink sunset, NO daytime. Layout is canopy rear canvas behind Wei Yan, table left, path opening right. No other person, no foreground player's body or spear, no text, no labels, no subtitles, no storyboard panels, no graphic overlays. Muted brown/gray real cloth and skin, restrained warm lantern, natural detailed shadows. This is a continuity reference rather than poster art. Preserve the existing film actor appearance from image 1.

Edit image 1 into one clean wider 16:9 cinematic live action continuity reference. Preserve EXACT SAME TWO actors, their faces, clothes, armor and relative positions: the older personal guard stands camera LEFT at x25%, young Jiang Wei in blue-gray collar stands camera RIGHT at x68%; both stationary outside the CLOSED main tent, looking toward the camera, mouths closed. Widen modestly to show thighs and ground, preserving tent behind them. Main tent flap stays closed at center with only a very narrow warm slit; no visible interior. Image 2 specifies exact main tent architecture and prop placement: a fire brazier each side of door, wooden notice board to the RIGHT of door, NOT left. At far right notice papers may be oblique/out of focus with no legible characters. Use same fully-night charcoal blue exposure as image 2; no pink twilight. No additional person, no new costumes or weapons, no foreground player shoulders, hands or spear. No text, arrows, labels, subtitles, collage, captions or dark masking rectangles. Natural skin, actual cloth and worn armor, restrained firelight, not orange/blue filter. Keep two actors distinct, maintain image1 identities rather than recasting. A calm coherent master shot for matching several video shots.
